jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

With a chance to collaborate each day with colleagues around the globe, you will manage your product fleet from sales to service team handover. A typical day of the LGT Fleet Manager offers a mix of project management activities, technical management with our design teams, collaboration with field service and engineering validation teams, and some of the high-level financial projections for your decisions.

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Support the implementation of new combustion systems into serial production
* Own the roadmap for new unit product fleet implementation through service handover
* Ensure cross-project prioritization and management of the combustion delivery load plan, aligning with capacity and service requirements
* Develop, communicate, and implement unit-specific fleet plans
* Coordinate technical and operational actions to address combustion-related challenges affecting fleet performance or production activities
* Drive cross-functional alignment among Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain organizations while managing simultaneous and complex constraints within the fleet

What You Bring
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related field
* Strong experience in power project management, complex task coordination, and technical gas turbine systems
* Essential familiarity with industrial gas turbines and advantageous knowledge of hot gas path part engineering, manufacturing, and servicing
* Excellent communication skills, strong organizational capabilities, and confidence in managing multiple simultaneous tasks
* Proficiency in SAP as an advantage
* Fluent German and English skills

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) – Experimental Cancer Neuroscience (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.employer_name: Universitätsklinikum der Technischen Universität München AöR
jobs.description:
Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) – Experimental Cancer Neuroscience

Full- or part-time | temporary (36 months) | Klinik und Poliklinik für Chirurgie

We are seeking an exceptional and highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join our internationally active research group at the interface of cancer biology, neuroscience and tumor immunology.
Our group investigates how the nervous system shapes tumor initiation, progression, invasion, metastasis and cancer-associated symptoms, with a particular focus on pancreatic cancer and cancer neuroscience. We combine mechanistic cancer biology with neuroscience, immunology, advanced in vivo models, spatial and single-cell technologies, functional imaging and translational human studies.
Our ambition is clear: to define and lead emerging concepts in cancer neuroscience rather than merely follow them.
The laboratory operates in a highly competitive and well-funded environment with support from, among others, the European Research Council (ERC), Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG), Deutsche Krebshilfe and Else Kröner-Fresenius-Stiftung, and is embedded in a strong national and international network in cancer neuroscience.

Your responsibilities:

The successful candidate will take a central scientific role in our experimental program and will contribute to the conception, execution and development of ambitious projects addressing neural–tumor–immune interactions.

Depending on expertise, projects may include:

- mechanistic studies of neuron–cancer and neuro–immune interactions
- functional characterization of neural signaling pathways in cancer
- genetically engineered and orthotopic in vivo tumor models
- manipulation of neuronal, immune and tumor-cell populations
- advanced imaging and molecular phenotyping
- integration of molecular, cellular and spatial data with functional experiments
- development of new experimental concepts and therapeutic strategies in cancer neuroscience

A particularly important aspect of the position is the strategic management and further development of our animal experimentation platform.

This may include:

- preparation and coordination of animal study applications and amendments
- planning and supervision of complex in vivo experiments
- establishment and optimization of experimental mouse models
- management of genetically modified mouse colonies
- breeding strategy, genotyping and colony planning
- coordination with animal facilities, authorities and collaborating laboratories
- implementation of high standards in experimental design, documentation and animal welfare

Your profile:

We are looking for a scientist with a strong experimental background in at least one – preferably several – of the following fields: Cancer Biology | Tumor Immunology | Neuroscience | Neuroimmunology | Molecular Biology

You should have:

- a PhD or equivalent doctoral degree in a relevant life-science discipline
- substantial hands-on experience in experimental biomedical research as well as experience with in vivo models, ideally tumor models and/or neuroscience models
- strong expertise in molecular and cellular biology and the ability to independently design, troubleshoot and drive complex experiments
- excellent scientific communication skills in English
- a highly collaborative but intellectually independent working style

Particularly desirable is extensive experience with:

- animal experimentation and experimental planning and preparation or management of animal experimentation applications
- genetically engineered mouse models as well as mouse breeding and colony management
- tumor models and neuroscience or neuroimmunology techniques

We offer you:

- This is not intended to be a purely technical postdoctoral position.
- We offer the opportunity to become a scientifically visible and intellectually independent member of a rapidly developing research program, with substantial room to shape projects and develop an individual research profile. 
- Our goal is to attract scientists who want to build a field, not simply complete a project.
- You will work in an internationally competitive cancer neuroscience environment; ERC-, DFG-, Deutsche Krebshilfe- and foundation-funded research programs; highly interdisciplinary collaborations spanning cancer biology, neuroscience, immunology, surgery, pathology, spatial biology and computational biology
- We offe you projects with strong potential for high-impact publications and a translational environment with direct access to human cancer material and clinically relevant questions as well as an international network of leading scientists in the emerging field of Cancer Neuroscience
- EGYM well pass, corporate benefits and discounts (e.g. Käfer), cafeteria, sports and cultural offers
- Working in the heart of Munich at Max-Weber-Platz with very good accessibility by public transport such as the subway, S-Bahn or tram 

We look forward to meeting you!

Contact: Sarah Mößmer | 089 / 4140 –2044 | Klinik und Poliklinik für Chirurgie

Klinik und Poliklinik für Chirurgie

TUM Klinikum
Rechts der Isar
Ismaninger Straße 22
81675 München

jobs.occupation: B2C International Growth Manager - French Market (m/f/d) (Growth-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Your missionAs our B2C International Growth Manager (French Market), you'll step into a role with purpose, ownership, and the opportunity to shape the future of the world's #1 mobile diagnostics solution. You'll join our Internationalization Team, driving B2C growth across international markets, with the Francophone markets as initial focus, by bringing Carly to millions of drivers through impactful campaigns, bold growth initiatives, and memorable brand experiences. As you expand our global reach, you'll also support the growth of our B2B business through targeted marketing initiatives- all within a collaborative, international environment that values authenticity, inclusion, and continuous learning.
Your responsibilities
• Own the B2C growth strategy for the Francophone and other international markets, driving customer acquisition, brand awareness, and recurring revenue through high-impact marketing initiatives.
• Build Carly's brand visibility through PR initiatives, TV campaigns, and strategic marketing activities that strengthen awareness in local markets.
• Identify, test, and validate new acquisition channels by defining clear hypotheses, measuring performance, and scaling successful initiatives through data-driven decision making.
• Collaborate closely with Marketing, Sales, and Enterprise teams to generate qualified B2B leads, improve conversion workflows, and support international sales initiatives.
• Own customer and market intelligence by conducting continuous research, refreshing customer personas, and proactively identifying market trends that influence growth opportunities.
• Act as the go-to expert for your markets, providing actionable insights and supporting cross-functional teams with market-specific strategies and recommendations.

Your profile
• 5+ years of experience in B2C Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, International Expansion, Business Development, or a similar role.
• Proven track record of owning and delivering growth initiatives such as PR campaigns, product launches, brand campaigns, TV campaigns, strategic marketing projects, or similar high-impact initiatives.
• An entrepreneurial, hands-on mindset with the ability to adapt quickly, embrace change, and thrive in fast-moving environments.
• Experience taking ownership of projects from concept through execution while balancing strategy with operational excellence.
• Strong analytical skills and confidence using data to prioritize opportunities, evaluate experiments, and optimize business outcomes.
• Experience working across European markets, with a solid understanding of international customer behavior and localization.
• Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with experience working across multidisciplinary and multicultural teams.
• French native (C2) and English (C1); additional languages are a strong advantage.

Why us?
• Inclusive and supportive culture that values authenticity and growth—no walls, no limits, no bureaucracy.
• Clear strategy and purpose-driven impact—you'll know exactly how your work drives Carly's mission.
• Data-driven decisions and open dashboards—full transparency on goals, growth, and results.
• Cross-functional collaboration—strong management, hands-on workshops, and a high learning curve.
• Competitive compensation and 100% company-supported equipment to help you do your best work.
• Stable and sustainable growth.
• A passionate, international team based in the heart of Munich—with a view of the Alps!

Curious what the experience at Carly is like? Our team spans 30+ nationalities, and we believe in transparency, autonomy, and building meaningful relationships. Learn more on our Culture & Careers page.

About usCarly is a cartech company improving car repair and maintenance for millions of car fans worldwide. We provide curated repair and maintenance knowledge and package it in a suitable format. With the help of our product, our customers receive actionable advice. They can then cover a large part of their repair and maintenance on their own, placing them back in control over their vehicles.

While we have been steadily growing and providing new services to our customers over the past years, there is still so much to do, and you can help us achieve it. So join us in our central Munich offices and help us bring joy to more car fans worldwide.

What is Carly's purpose?
Carly pairs real-time data with mechanical expertise to improve car fans' repair and maintenance experiences. Our aim is to Share Knowledge, Deliver Relevance and Provide Joy to car fans and people with car issues.

What is Carly's vision?

We want to be top of mind for car fans regarding repair and maintenance.

Be a part of our driven team and conquer the automotive world with us!

jobs.occupation: Senior Odoo Engineer ERP & E-Commerce (all genders) (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
IntroductionDo you want to do more than just maintain an ERP system—do you want to help shape its future? As a Senior Odoo Engineer for ERP & E-Commerce (all genders), you’ll take responsibility for our Odoo platform—the system that powers sales, order processing, logistics, and accounting.
You’ll further develop our in-house modules, continue the migration to the Odoo standard, integrate new countries, standardize payment processes, and build our new online store—ensuring it’s fully upgradeable, with streamlined workflows and genuine creative freedom.
Your mission
• The focus is on further developing our Odoo platform—which includes approximately 25 in-house modules—and upgrading it to the target version. In doing so, you’ll rely on an upgrade-friendly architecture based on inheritance rather than modifications to the Odoo core
• Another key focus of your work will be migrating existing processes to the Odoo standard and integrating new countries—including localization, accounting, and country-specific requirements
• You’ll ensure seamless and efficient payment processes by integrating PSP connections, SEPA direct debit, and PSD2/SCA, and by managing the interfaces with adjacent systems
• Together with the relevant stakeholders, you’ll implement our new, mobile-friendly website and online store based on Odoo E-Commerce
• You ensure code quality and testability, document architecture and design decisions, and provide technical guidance to development partners

Your profile
• You have several years of experience in Odoo development with Python and have implemented your own modules from requirements to go-live
• You have worked with Odoo Enterprise in production environments—including Odoo.sh—for several years and are proficient with Git in professional development and deployment processes

jobs.description:
As a Senior Consultant / Manager (f|m|x), you advise our clients in
the banking sector and financial services industry on complex topics
related to liquidity and market price risk. You analyze their current
situation, identify new requirements early on and, together with your
team, develop tailored solutions – from the initial idea all the way
to implementation. In this role, you effectively drive the continued
development of your clients’ liquidity risk management, enabling
well‑founded decision-making. You assume subject-matter
responsibility, manage collaboration within the project and shape the
content development of our consulting approaches. Your tasks: You
support and lead exciting (sub-)projects at banks and financial
services providers in their liquidity and market price risk
management, taking full responsibility – from gap analyses and the
design of client-specific solutions through to implementation. You
develop integrated management approaches for liquidity and market
price risk, bank-wide liquidity risk stress tests and quantitative
modeling frameworks, for example for risk measurement or interest
rate, margin and liquidity cash flow analyses. In addition, you design
methodological frameworks (for example in the ILAAP context) and
develop solutions to implement IRRBB and CSRBB requirements as well as
net interest income (NII) simulations. As part of your role, you also
ensure the effective integration of regulatory requirements, for
instance with respect to ICAAP and ILAAP as well as IRRBB and CSRBB.
You take responsibility for your own deliverables and those of your
team and proactively advance topics. With your strong team orientation
and professionalism, you foster trust-based collaboration – both
within the team and with our clients. You also mentor junior
colleagues, developing both their professional capabilities and
personal strengths, and thus contribute to the team’s growth. You
actively help shape the ongoing enhancement of our consulting
portfolio, identify relevant market potential at an early stage and
derive concrete ideas from it. With your expertise, you support the
development of new offerings and the acquisition of new client
mandates. Your skills: You hold a degree in mathematics, (business)
informatics, physics, statistics or economics, ideally supplemented by
certifications such as FRM or CFA. You have at least three years of
professional experience in consulting or the financial industry.
Proven involvement in leading bank-specific implementation projects in
liquidity and market price risk management is an advantage, and
initial exposure to specialist leadership (for example coordinating
team members) is also part of your profile. You have a solid
understanding of liquidity and market price risk management as well as
the ICAAP and ILAAP frameworks. You confidently apply your analytical
and quantitative skills in modeling and data analysis; programming
skills in Python or R are explicitly welcome. You are familiar with
relevant European and German regulatory requirements, including EBA
Guidelines on IRRBB and CSRBB, SREP requirements, ICAAP and ILAAP.
Initial experience in dealing professionally with external audits is a
plus. You work and think in a structured and solution-oriented manner
and communicate clearly. A client- and team-oriented way of working
comes naturally to you, especially when assuming responsibility within
a team and engaging effectively with different people and situations.
You have excellent command of the German language (at least C1 level,
business-fluent proficiency) and good English language skills (at
least B2 level, fluent), both written and spoken. #LI-LARA #LI-hybrid
Your benefits Insurances & Pension Schemes: Safely on the road with
zeb—in Germany, you are also privately insured via a group accident
insurance policy. For business trips abroad, there is an additional
travel health insurance and you can also take out a company pension
plan with zeb. Mobile Work: Thanks to our technical equipment, remote
work is possible from anywhere – regardless of whether you are on
the train, at home or in the office. zeb.life: Your life is
changing—and we would like to accompany you through the different
phases. zeb.life offers you support for example in childcare, life
situation management and eldercare or in finding concierge services.
Working Time Models: The principle of "trust-based hours” applies
for all our employees, enabling flexible schedules. For permanent
employees, part-time models are also possible: you can develop your
part-time model in consultation with your CDC (Career Development
Counselor) and in consideration of your project and adapt it as
required. Define your working time model according to your personal
needs and adapt your working hours to your current life situation. As
a contract model, Family & More offers a guarantee of travel-free
weekdays that are contractually fixed. Depending on the reduction of
travel activities, your salary will be adjusted for a fixed period of
time.

YOUR PROFILE

WHAT WE OFFER

html Full-Cycle Sales – Space Tech (all genders)Taufkirchen, Garching / Full-time / Permanent employee About us

Blackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.

More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.

Full-Cycle Sales – Space Tech (all genders)
Taufkirchen, Garching / Full-time / Permanent employee YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

We build carbon-fiber pressure vessels that go into orbit. You'll build the pipeline that gets them there.

This is a pure hunting role: cold calls, first meetings, follow-ups, closed contracts. You own the full cycle start to finish, no handoffs. If you've spent the last 3-5 years on a structured, metrics-driven sales floor and you measure your week in calls made, meetings booked, and deals closed, this is your next step up.

What You'll Do:

- Build your own pipeline from scratch through cold calls and outbound prospecting across the European space market.
- Run the full sales cycle yourself: first touch, qualification, technical discovery, proposal, close.
- Track and hit weekly and monthly activity and revenue targets, the same rhythm you already run today.
- Get in front of customers early and often, calls, site visits, trade shows included.
- Learn the technical side of COPVs on the job. We train you on the product. You bring the hunting instinct.

YOUR PROFILE

- 3-5 years in full-cycle B2B sales, ideally from a structured, quota-driven sales organization.
- A daily habit of outbound activity: calls, outreach, pipeline building, not waiting on inbound leads.
- Competitive drive. You track your numbers because you want to win, not because someone's watching.
- Curiosity about how things are made. No aerospace background required, we teach you the product.
- Fluent English. German is a plus.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Base salary at 60-80% of OTE, uncapped variable on top. You control your upside.
- Short paths, fast decisions, no layers between you and the people who call the shots.
- Real coaching and structure. You always know your number and how you're tracking against it.
- Germany Ticket, EGYM Wellpass, or a tax-free GivveCard, your call.
- Fresh shared lunch every day, different daily, peak team bonding.
